note: The price job's switch (.github/workflows/college-baseball-prices.yml), committed so turning it on or off is a reviewed change. It takes the place of the repository variable CBASE_PRICES, which no tool in the development session can set. The second switch is the gateway's own row, public.odds_api_sports.baseball_ncaa: while it is disabled the gateway refuses every request and nothing is bought. To stop without a commit, set the repository variable CBASE_PRICES to off, or run select public.odds_api_set_sport('baseball_ncaa', false);
